title: Kids Ask «Поясни» for a Video Right From the App | vitalii.no
description:
Before now, a child who wanted an explainer video had to ask outside the app entirely — parents had no way to see the question, cancel it, or stop the shared queue from being flooded.

A new Explain page lets a child hold the record button and simply speak the question. The gate transcribes it and reads it back for confirmation before anything is queued, enforced server-side. Parents see every question land in real time, can cancel anything still waiting, or type a question themselves instead of speaking it.

The shared queue is now protected by a real per-child cap of 2 questions a day, replacing a queue that had no limit at all.
